name: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ne-HPV
sources: International Agency for Research on Cancer

what_is_it.heading: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho - ingxenye engezansi yesibeletho. Cishe zonke izimo (ngaphezu kwama-99%) zibangelwa ukutheleleka kwesikhathi eside ngezinhlobo eziyingozi kakhulu ze-HPV (Human Papillomavirus).
paragraphs: I-HPV ivame kakhulu - abantu abaningi abathanda ucansi bayayibamba ngesikhathi esithile. Umzimba ususa izifo eziningi ze-HPV phakathi nonyaka noma emibili. Kodwa uma uhlobo oluyingozi kakhulu luqhubeka iminyaka eyi-10-15, lungabangela amangqamuzana omlomo wesibeletho ukuthi ashintshe kancane abe umdlavuza wangaphambi komdlavuza, bese kuba umdlavuza.

Lesi sikhathi eside yiso esenza umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ungomunye wemidlavuza evikeleke kakhulu emhlabeni. Ukuhlolwa (i-Pap smear noma ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV) kubamba izinguquko zeseli eminyakeni ngaphambi kokuba umdlavuza uqhamuke - lapho ukwelashwa kulula. Umgomo we-HPV uvimbela izifo eziwudalayo kwasekuqaleni.

items.headline: Okwesibili okuvame kakhulu
items.body: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ungowesibili kwabesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika. Amanani aphezulu kakhulu kwabesifazane abaneminyaka engu-35 kuya ku-55.

items.headline: 99% i-HPV
items.body: Ngaphezu kuka-99% womdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ubangelwa ukutheleleka kwe-HPV yesikhathi eside. Ukumisa i-HPV kunqanda umdlavuza.

items.headline: Umuthi wokugoma wamahhala
items.body: Umgomo we-HPV umahhala emantombazaneni eBanga lesi-5 (futhi manje nabafana ezifundazweni eziningi) ngohlelo lwesikole. Okuhle kakhulu kunikezwe ngaphambi kokuqala kocansi.

items.headline: Ama-Pap smear asindisa izimpilo
items.body: I-Pap smear yamahhala njalo eminyakeni eyi-10 kusukela eminyakeni engama-30 emitholampilo kahulumeni. Njalo eminyakeni emi-3 uma une-HIV. Ibamba izinguquko ngaphambi komdlavuza.

pull_quote.text: Uma wonke umuntu wesifazane waseNingizimu Afrika engagonywa eseyintombazane futhi ahlolwe lapho esekhulile, singawuqeda umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho phakathi nesizukulwane. Amathuluzi akhona. Bakhululekile.

signs.heading: Ongase ukuqaphele
signs.lede: Izinguquko zangaphambi kwesikhathi komlomo wesibeletho - okuhlanganisa umdlavuza wangaphambi komdlavuza kanye nomdlavuza wangaphambi kwesikhathi - ngokuvamile azibangeli zimpawu. Yingakho ukuhlolwa kubalulekile. Izimpawu zivela lapho umdlavuza usuthuthuke kakhulu.

items.title: Early - silent
items.description: Umdlavuza wangaphambi komdlavuza kanye nomdlavuza wangaphambi kwesikhathi ngokuvamile awubangeli zimpawu. I-Pap smear noma ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kuphela okushintsha lokhu kusenesikhathi.

items.title: Kamuva - ukopha
items.description: Ukopha phakathi kokuya esikhathini, ngemva kocansi, noma ngemva kokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini. Izikhathi ezinzima noma ezinde kunokuvamile. Ukukhishwa okungajwayelekile kwesitho sangasese sowesifazane.

items.title: Okuthuthukile — bonana nodokotela
items.description: Ubuhlungu be-pelvic, ubuhlungu beqolo, ubuhlungu ngesikhathi socansi, ukuvuvukala komlenze, igazi emchameni noma esitulweni. Lezi zidinga ukuhlolwa okuphuthumayo.

items.myth: Abesifazane kuphela abanabalingani abaningi abathola i-HPV.
items.fact: I-HPV ivame kakhulu - iningi labantu abathanda ucansi bayayibamba. Ngisho nozakwethu oyedwa angawudlulisela. Ukugoma kuvikela kungakhathaliseki umlando wozakwethu.

items.myth: Umgomo we-HPV ukhuthaza abantu abasha ukuthi baqale ucansi kusenesikhathi.
items.fact: Iminyaka yocwaningo ayikhombisi ukuxhumana phakathi kokugonyelwa i-HPV kanye nokwenza ucansi kwangaphambi kwesikhathi. Umuthi wokugoma usebenza kangcono uma unikezwa ngaphambi kwanoma yikuphi ukuchayeka ocansini.

items.myth: Uma benginomgomo we-HPV, angiwadingi ama-Pap smear.
items.fact: Umgomo uvimbela iningi kodwa hhayi zonke izinhlobo ze-HPV eziyingozi kakhulu. Ukuhlola kusabalulekile - umuthi wokugoma kanye nokuhlolwa ndawonye kuwukuvikela okuqine kakhulu.

items.myth: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ugijima emindenini - akukho engingakwenza.
items.fact: Umlando womndeni uyingozi encane kakhulu. Ukutheleleka nge-HPV kuyimbangela cishe yawo wonke umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho - futhi i-HPV iyavinjelwa futhi ibonakale.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokuzivikela
prevention.lede: Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ungomunye wemidlavuza evikeleke kakhulu ngoba kukhona kokubili umgomo kanye nokuhlolwa okusebenzayo. Wonke umuntu wesifazane omdala kufanele alwazi uhlelo lwakhe.

items.title: Umgomo we-HPV
items.description: Kumahhala eNingizimu Afrika emantombazaneni eBanga lesi-5 (nabafana ezifundazweni eziningi). Okuhle kakhulu ngaphambi kokuba umsebenzi wocansi uqale kodwa usebenze kunoma iyiphi iminyaka - cela umtholampilo wakho kuze kube yiminyaka engama-45.

items.title: Ama-Pap smear ajwayelekile
items.description: Kumahhala emitholampilo kusukela eminyakeni engama-30, njalo eminyakeni eyi-10 uma kujwayelekile. Njalo eminyakeni emi-3 uma une-HIV. Qala kusenesikhathi futhi ubuke kaningi uma unomlando wemiphumela engajwayelekile.

items.title: Amakhondomu
items.description: Yehlisa ukudluliswa kwe-HPV kodwa ungayiqedi — I-HPV ingasabalala esikhumbeni esingavalwanga yikhondomu. Isasebenziseka, ikakhulukazi ngozakwethu abasha.

items.title: Ungabhemi
items.description: Ukubhema kwenza buthaka ikhono lomlomo wesibeletho lokusula ukutheleleka nge-HPV futhi kuphinda kabili ingozi yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho kwabesifazane abane-HPV.

items.title: Uma unendodakazi efunda iBanga lesi-5
items.description: Qiniseka ukuthi uthola umgomo we-HPV ngohlelo lwesikole. Imithamo emibili, mahhala, inikezwa ngokwehlukana kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Leli ithuluzi elilodwa elinamandla kunawo wonke lokuvimbela umdlavuza esinalo.

items.title: Uma uneminyaka engu-30 noma ngaphezulu
items.description: Bhuka i-Pap smear kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni uma ungazange ube nayo eminyakeni eyi-10 edlule. Kumahhala, kuthatha imizuzu emihlanu, kuphumela emavikini angu-2-4.

items.title: Uma une-HIV
items.description: Ukuhlolwa kwenzeka njalo eminyakeni emi-3 kungakhathaliseki ubudala, kusukela ekuxilongweni kuye phambili. I-HPV iziphatha kabi kakhulu nge-HIV - ungeqi.

items.title: Uma wopha ngendlela engavamile
items.description: Ukopha phakathi kokuya esikhathini, ngemva kocansi, noma ngemva kokunqamuka kokuya esikhathini - bonana nomtholampilo. Izimbangela eziningi akuwona umdlavuza, kodwa umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ungenye yezimbangela ezidinga ukusheshe zibanjwe.

items.title: Uma i-Pap smear yakho ingajwayelekile
items.description: Ungabi novalo. Imiphumela eminingi engajwayelekile iwumdlavuza wangaphambi komdlavuza ongelashwa ngokuvakasha okukodwa. Landela - isistimu iyasebenza uma ugcina ama-aphoyintimenti akho.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukuhlolwa komlomo wesibeletho, ukwelashwa ngaphambi komdlavuza, kanye nomgomo we-HPV konke kumahhala emitholampilo yomphakathi waseNingizimu Afrika. Ingqalasizinda yokuvikela umdlavuza ikhona - yisebenzise.

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Imithi yokugomela i-HPV yamahhala, i-Pap smear, nokulandelelwa kwemiphumela engajwayelekile
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo

helplines.name: umugqa wentsha we-loveLife
helplines.description: Kwabesifazane abasebasha - ulwazi oluyimfihlo mayelana ne-HPV nokuhlolwa
